name: Amplified Rage [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Your rage inspires other raging allies, making their rage even more powerful.

Prerequisite(s): Half-orc or orc, rage class feature.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are raging and adjacent to a raging ally, such as those under the effects of a rage spell or rage monster ability, or flanking the same opponent as a raging ally, their morale bonuses to Strength and Constitution increase by +4. This feat does not stack with itself (your ally only gains this bonus from one qualifying ally, regardless of how many are adjacent to them).
